text: {"rationale":"Test selective caching (s3, s4) and smaller limits with SET_BASED s5 to find low-memory, low-get Pareto points between full caching and no caching.","configs":[{"s1":"BULK_50","s2":"LOOKUP_SQL","s3":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s4":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s5":"SET_BASED"},{"s1":"BULK_50","s2":"LOOKUP_SQL","s3":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s4":"LOOKUP_SQL","s5":"SET_BASED"},{"s1":"BULK_50","s2":"LOOKUP_SQL","s3":"LOOKUP_SQL","s4":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s5":"SET_BASED"},{"s1":"BULK_500","s2":"LOOKUP_SQL","s3":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s4":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s5":"SET_BASED"},{"s1":"BULK_50","s2":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s3":"LOOKUP_CACHE","s4":"LOOKUP_SQL","s5":"SET_BASED"}]}

{"rationale":"Sample diverse values across s1 and s5 to map primary cost influences, while flipping binary parameters s2, s3, s4 from the original baseline.","configs":[{"s1":"A","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"A"},{"s1":"B","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"B"},{"s1":"C","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"E","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"A","s5":"E"},{"s1":"D","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"A"}]}

{"rationale":"Configurations with s2=A, s3=B, s4=B drastically reduce f1. Pair them with s1=E and s5=E (both linked to low f2) or test s1=C and s5=C to discover new trade-offs along the Pareto front.","configs":[{"s1":"E","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"E"},{"s1":"C","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"C","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"E"},{"s1":"E","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"B"},{"s1":"D","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"E"}]}

{"rationale":"Config 6 achieved the best f1 with s1=D, s3=B, s4=B. Blending features of config 1 (lowest f2) and config 6 (lowest f1) targets favorable trade-offs across s2, s5, and s1=B.","configs":[{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"B"},{"s1":"D","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"B"},{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"A"},{"s1":"B","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"A"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"B"}]}

{"rationale":"Configuration 11 with s1=D, s2=B, s3=A, s4=B achieved the lowest f1 (4787) when s5=D. Testing s5=A explores further f1/f2 reductions for this favorable sub-branch, while s1=E variants trade f2 for low f1.","configs":[{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"A"},{"s1":"E","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"E","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"E"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"D","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"D"}]}

{"rationale":"Explore combinations of s1=C and s1=E with varied intermediate sites s2-s4 and low-cost s5 labels (A, C, D) to find solutions dominating the current front between f1=37k and 91k.","configs":[{"s1":"C","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"C","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"D"},{"s1":"E","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"C","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"A"},{"s1":"E","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"D"}]}

{"rationale":"s1=C with s2=B, s3=B gives low f1, while s2=A gives lower f2. Evaluating s5=E with s1=C and combinations of s2/s3/s4 explores new optimal trade-offs in the front.","configs":[{"s1":"C","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"E"},{"s1":"C","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"C","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"C"},{"s1":"E","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"C"},{"s1":"C","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"C"}]}

{"rationale":"s4=B combined with s3=B or s3=A yielded strong f1 reductions. Testing s1=A with s4=B can explore low f2 regions, while s2=A with s4=B could push f1 even lower.","configs":[{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"A"},{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"A"},{"s1":"B","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"A"},{"s1":"C","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"A"},{"s1":"E","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"A"}]}

{"rationale":"Sample diverse values across top-level sites s1 and s5 to explore the global space and test s1 variants, including conditional masking when s1=E.","configs":[{"s1":"A","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"A"},{"s1":"C","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"B"},{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"C"},{"s1":"E","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"D"},{"s1":"B","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"E"}]}

{"rationale":"s5=E strongly optimizes both objectives when combined with s2/s3/s4. With s1=A and s1=B, toggling subsets of s2, s3, s4 explores intermediate trade-offs between f1=4836 and f2=1984.","configs":[{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"E"},{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"B","s5":"E"},{"s1":"A","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"E"},{"s1":"B","s2":"A","s3":"B","s4":"B","s5":"E"},{"s1":"D","s2":"B","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"E"}]}

{"rationale":"s2=B, s3=B, s4=A, s5=A gives optimal f1 across s1 variants. Testing unexplored s5 values (B, C, D) on the high-performing backbone (s1=E/A, s2=B, s3=B, s4=A) may yield better trade-offs.","configs":[{"s1":"E","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"A","s5":"B"},{"s1":"A","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"A","s5":"B"},{"s1":"E","s2":"B","s3":"B","s4":"A","s5":"C"},{"s1":"B","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"A"},{"s1":"D","s2":"A","s3":"A","s4":"A","s5":"A"}]}
